nodes.name: TargetController
nodes.responsibility: Target is visible beside the composer Submission captures target and supporting-context identities Target changes are explicit and preserve draft text
interfaces: Target kind, identity, label, and source revision when available

nodes.name: SurfaceRegistry
nodes.responsibility: Workspace can arrange surfaces using their declared needs Selection is available to the composer without changing its target Missing data is visibly distinguished from empty content
interfaces: Surface identity and presented work reference
Selection references and known source revision
Minimum readable space and supported presentation modes

nodes.name: LayoutController
nodes.responsibility: Preview leaves the current arrangement intact Explicit Apply selects a valid current proposal Restore changes arrangement without undoing artifact edits
interfaces: Proposed arrangement, reason, and affected surfaces
Pinned choices and surface space needs

nodes.name: PinPolicy
nodes.responsibility: Pin state is visible and reversible Proposals respect pinned roles and positions Temporary fit fallback preserves the preferred arrangement
interfaces: Explicit user move, unpin, or viewport change

nodes.name: SessionStore
nodes.responsibility: One conversation remains available at bottom center Chat expands upward or contracts without losing draft or target Returning to a surface restores its working position

nodes.name: AttentionStore
nodes.responsibility: Blocking conditions are visible near their work and in the compact attention overview Routine receipts remain inspectable on demand Acknowledging a notice leaves unresolved work visibly unresolved
interfaces: Attention identity, associated work, and source revision
Active, acknowledged, resolved, or stale state

nodes.name: WorkspaceView
nodes.responsibility: Persistent DOM panels, bottom-center chat, semantic controls, graph interactions and responsive layout.
